title: Run.Started
description: The payload of a run's first event (topic troupe.core.runs.aggregate:Run.Started): who and what the run is, recorded when the runner's init arrives, or at the end of a run that never sent one. Field names are as recorded.

originator_topic.description: The event-sourcing library's name for the aggregate the stream holds.

runner_reported.description: The runner's name and version from its init. Absent: the runner never sent one.

direction.description: The artifact reference of the run's direction: what the actor was asked to do.

config.description: The config version the run used: the ids of the config stream's heads, sorted. Working out config at that version gives the actor's runner, options, effect check and character.
